title: Document photo specification
description: One record describes the photo requirements for a single document (passport, visa, ID card, licence or other photo ID). All physical measurements are in millimetres.

id.description: Stable record id within this dataset.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase. Non-country entries use the closest administrative code (HK, MO, PS) or EU.

country.description: Lowercase slug used by the source system, e.g. united_states.

documentId.description: Stable document identifier from the source system, e.g. us_passport. Unique together with countryCode.

width.description: Photo width expressed in the unit given by `unit`.

height.description: Photo height expressed in the unit given by `unit`.

unit.description: Unit for width and height. Physical print sizes must not be mixed with pixel sizes.

widthMm.description: Width in millimetres. Present for mm and inch records; omitted for pixel-only records.

heightMm.description: Height in millimetres. Present for mm and inch records; omitted for pixel-only records.

pixelWidth.description: Pixel width of the digital variant, when the same document also has a pixel specification.

pixelHeight.description: Pixel height of the digital variant.

dpi.description: Resolution the specification is written for. 300 is the common print default, 600 is used by several European authorities.

backgroundColor.description: Required background colour as a lowercase hex RGB value, e.g. #ffffff for white.

headMinMm.description: Minimum chin-to-crown height in millimetres. Omitted when the requirement is not verified.

eyeLineMinMm.description: Minimum distance from the bottom edge of the photo to the eye line, in millimetres.

eyeLineMaxMm.description: Maximum distance from the bottom edge of the photo to the eye line, in millimetres.

glassesAllowed.description: Whether glasses may be worn in the photo. Omitted when the rule is not verified for this document.

expressionStrict.description: True when the neutral-expression rule is a hard legal requirement, false when it is only a preference (for example the US passport).

expression.description: Free-text expression guidance taken from the issuing authority.

recencyMonths.description: Maximum age of the photo in months. 6 is the common rule, 1 is used by some authorities.

guide.description: Link to the illustrated requirements guide for this country on idphotowork.com.

source.description: Source used to justify a correction or to confirm a value: an official publication, or the country guide that cites one.

needsReview.description: True when the size is disputed between sources or has not been confirmed. Treat these records as provisional.

reviewNote.description: Why the record is flagged for review.
